messages:
Tara M: Heads-up team — final SEO preflight for the Plume launch posts + webinar. Need a short playbook: keyword assignment, JSON-LD for landing and two posts, internal anchor plan, and a redirects cascade that preserves link equity. Target: lock by EOD today.

Evan R: I'll do redirects cascade + canonical rules. Plan: 1) soft-redirects (302) for 48h to monitor traffic, then 301 consolidation; 2) keep interim rel=canonical pointing to chosen canonical; 3) capture legacy slugs in CSV. Sample: `source,target,type`
`/plume_old,/plume-orbit,302`
`/plume_old,/plume-orbit,301 # switch after 48h`

June K: I'll map keywords — primary keywords to launch post, secondary to benchmark narrative, long-tail to evergreen guide. Also will add internal links from product docs to benchmarks to signal topical depth.

Tara M: Good. Also plan an anchor diversity matrix — don't repeat exact-match anchors more than twice. Use partial-match anchors like "Plume benchmarks" vs "benchmark results".

Mark (publish-bot): Reminder: upload redirects CSV to `s3://redwood-deploy/redirects/plume-cascade.csv` and then run `/deploy redirects plume-cascade`. Bot will post status.

Olivia (seo-bot): Add JSON-LD for landing — Event + potentialFAQ. Tiny validated example below (paste as-is into head):
`{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Plume Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-20T15:00:00Z","url":"https://www.redwood.ai/plume-orbit"}`

Evan R: Also: sitemap strategy — add new URLs to sitemap index, submit to Search Console after 302 window ends, then resubmit post-301. Keeps crawl consistent.

June K: A/B test idea: include FAQ schema on launch post variant B only and measure impressions for rich snippets. Tag GTM links with `&variant=B` for the test.

Tara M: Acceptance checklist: redirects in S3, canonical tags verified, JSON-LD present on landing + 2 posts, anchor map merged into copy, sitemap submitted, and A/B flag in GTM. Drop 1-line status in the sheet when done.

Mark (publish-bot): After deploy run `publishing-bot check-schema https://www.redwood.ai/plume-orbit` and post output.

Olivia (seo-bot): Quick SEO note — adjust meta title on benchmarks to avoid title collision with launch post. Add date or "benchmarks" token.

Tara M: Thanks all — ping here if any infra blockers. Reconvene 9am tomorrow for post-deploy check. :rocket:
